text_block_list.text:
While walking through the academy grounds, 
I noticed a plushie lying all alone on the 
ground.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh――

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Could that over there... perhaps be a lost 
item?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Is that how it was?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Such a lonely expression. It's only 
natural, you must feel so helpless.
(…………*squeeze*)

She hugged the plushie as if comforting 
it. Both her expression and her gentle 
touch radiated warmth and kindness.

I wonder who owns this. I'd like to return 
it, but I have no idea whose it is. Is 
there any clue...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What a lovely coat. It must be very well 
cared for, I'm sure. This ribbon is 
pretty, too.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how cherished it was, its owner 
must surely feel the exact same way――

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, I saw someone 
just a moment ago...! Her hair was tied 
with the exact same white ribbon—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
――Someone who carried a strangely lonely 
air about them.
choice_data_list: Then, could you be that girl's...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It might just be a coincidence. Even so, 
it's probably best to ask.

After walking through the school for a 
while searching for the horse girl with 
the ribbon――at last.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ribbon
text_block_list.text: —! That girl...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Could it be... you found it for me?! Ah, 
aaaaaah...!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, so it really was yours after all. 
...What a relief.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Please, feel free to touch it with your 
own hands. ...Go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh...! I'm so sorry for leaving you all 
alone...! ――*Sniffle*............ Welcome 
back, Mimi-chan.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh.
choice_data_list:
Glad it made its way safely back to its 
owner.

Glad it made its way safely back to its 
owner.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Both of them look so peaceful. Both 
her, and that little girl.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Well... —Fufu, that is true♪ It makes me 
exceedingly happy as well.

I could feel her profound relief and joy. 
To wish so whole-heartedly for someone 
else's happinessâshe is truly such a 
pure, kind girl.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...My, if that's the case, it wouldn't 
apply only to me, would it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And for you, too――the one who reached out 
and watched over me with worried eyes.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that must be because your heart is 
so warm.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
By worrying for someone's loneliness and 
showing care, you can find happiness 
yourself— That kindness of yours is truly 
wonderful.
